output.sql: SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY net_revenue))::numeric, 2) AS median_net_order_value FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue = true AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Calculates the median net_revenue (without shipping) across completed orders (is_revenue = true) placed in calendar/fiscal year 2025, rounded to 2 decimals.
